ValidationRule.description: Percentages must be entered if Both is selected under Competitively Vended
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL( Competitively_Vended__c ,"Both"), OR( (ISBLANK( Vended__c )), (ISBLANK( Unvended__c )) ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter the percent of storage Vended and Unvended.
